b_int16.description: B: Full INT16 (w16a16, ESPDL_S3_INT16, minmax calib on 600 beats)

c0.description: C0: Default INT8 (w8a8, ESPDL_S3_INT8, KL calib on 600 beats)

c1.description: C1: Peak-Enriched INT8 (w8a8, KL calib on 600 base + 200 high-peak V/S/F train beats)

c2a.description: C2a: INT8 with Forced Input Exponent -4 (scale=0.0625, range +-7.94, 0% R-peak clipping)

c2b.description: C2b: INT8 with Forced Input Exponent -5 (scale=0.03125, range +-3.97, 2x finer P/T resolution)

c3.description: C3: Mixed Precision INT16+INT8 (Stem Conv1+MaxPool1 & Final Gemm in INT16, middle DS blocks in INT8, peak-enriched calib)

c_w8a16.description: C_W8A16: 8-bit Weights + 16-bit Activations (ESPDL_S3_W8A16, full 16-bit wave dynamic range)
